recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit for core. If current modifierExtension differential rendering is still wrong, verify or fix it in the current HL7 IG Publisher/tooling repositories with a regression test based on the FHIR-12883 scenario.
issue_request: FHIR-12883 was Published/Persuasive and reported that the FHIR 1.8 igpublisher.jar showed regular extensions in a profile differential view but showed modifierExtensions only in snapshot view, even though generated StructureDefinition XML and JSON contained modifierExtensions in both differential and snapshot.
initial_application: The issue was applied by historical git-svn commit 73125f8da33e250f5f3ea10b43b4667b342923f0, matching Jira's svn revision 11859 comment. That commit changed the old DSTU3 ProfileUtilities and NarrativeGenerator Java code, added modifierExtension snapshot-generation fixtures and assertions, and wired old IG Publisher narrative generation for StructureDefinition rendering.
additional_context: Current HL7/fhir no longer contains the old IG Publisher Java implementation or the DSTU3 ProfileUtilities file touched by the application commit. Commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b removed the IG Publisher from core because it had gone to Maven, and commit 7a2c3cd52484193783dcf3edf9b0c815e88d7aac later removed the old DSTU3 ProfileUtilities source. Current build-scoped core source keeps ImplementationGuide active and links to external IG Publisher documentation, but searches found no current publisher rendering implementation to edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no source changes. The historical fix was for tooling/rendering behavior now outside this core spec checkout.
